title: Cloud Cost Data Baseline

controlTest.positiveScenario: Replay sample `aws:cur` events with `matching activity` into `index=aws`. Confirm UC-4.11.1 returns >=1 row and the alert fires.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `aws:cur` traffic without `matching activity`. Confirm UC-4.11.1 returns zero rows and the alert does not fire.

dataSources: `index=aws` sourcetype=`aws:cur` collected via Splunk Add-on for AWS (Splunkbase 1876); validate ingest with `| stats count by sourcetype`.

index=aws sourcetype="aws:cur"

description: UC-4.11.1 — Cloud Cost Data Baseline: queries AWS `aws:cur` for configured audit predicates and returns actor, resource, and region context for audit review and change validation.
value: On AWS, cost anomalies and waste patterns for 'Cloud Cost Data Baseline' erode FinOps guardrails and often reveal compromised accounts mining resources or forgotten idle infrastructure. UC-4.11.1 drives critical-priority audit alerting before customer-impacting drift.
implementation: Enable aws:cur ingestion via the appropriate Splunk TA into index=aws.
visualization: Ingestion health single value and lag chart.
knownFalsePositives: Approved change windows; documented automation service principals; sandbox accounts excluded via lookup.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=aws`.
• Install and configure Splunk Add-on for AWS (Splunkbase 1876) with the modular input for `aws:cur`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): none.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `product_product_name` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Enable aws:cur ingestion via the appropriate Splunk TA into index=aws.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cur" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cur"
| table _time product_product_name lineItem_UsageAmount lineItem_UnblendedCost
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.11.1_cloud_cost_data_baseline_1"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `aws:cur` in `index=aws` to detect cloud cost data baseline. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the AWS Cost Explorer console for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `product_product_name` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_11_1_alert` with severity aligned to `critical` criticality. Dashboard: Ingestion health single value and lag chart..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Splunk Add-on for AWS (Splunkbase 1876) and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of cloud cost data baseline so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
